title: UX Experiment Variant Flow Compiler
description: Validates experiment variant specs: control group presence, feature flag alignment, terminal state declarations, analytics event parity, security bypass prevention, rollback behavior, and contract attestation. Produces experiment-variant-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract experiment-variant-spec.json from feature brief and variant definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and control group presence

pipeline.title: Variants
pipeline.description: Validate feature flag alignment, terminal states, and analytics event parity

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate security bypass prevention and rollback behavior

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: experiment-variant-spec.json exists with experiment_id(string), hypothesis(string), variants(array) of at least 2; each variant has id+name+flowRef+featureFlag

gates.title: Control Group
gates.description: Exactly one variant must have isControl:true — no more, no less

gates.title: Flag Alignment
gates.description: Every variant.featureFlag must be a non-empty string

gates.title: Terminal States
gates.description: Every variant must declare terminals array with at least one terminal: { type: success|failure|abandoned, description: string }

gates.title: Analytics Parity
gates.description: If spec has analyticsEvents, every event name must appear in all variants; missing events in any variant are violations

gates.title: No Security Bypass
gates.description: No variant may declare bypassAuth:true, bypassValidation:true, or skipGuards:true

gates.title: Rollback Declared
gates.description: Spec must declare rollbackBehavior: revert-to-control, disable-experiment, or gradual-ramp-down

gates.title: Experiment Variant Contract
gates.description: Version, unique variant ids, experiment_id non-empty, hypothesis non-empty, exactly one control

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled experiment variant specs

error_codes.UEV001: experiment-variant-spec.json missing or invalid — experiment_id, hypothesis, variants(>=2) with id+name+flowRef+featureFlag required
error_codes.UEV002: Control group missing or multiple — exactly one variant must have isControl:true
error_codes.UEV003: Variant missing or empty featureFlag — cannot be activated programmatically
error_codes.UEV004: Variant missing terminals array or no terminal with type and description
error_codes.UEV005: Analytics event parity violation — event name missing in one or more variants
error_codes.UEV006: Variant declares security bypass — bypassAuth, bypassValidation, or skipGuards not permitted
error_codes.UEV007: rollbackBehavior missing — must be revert-to-control, disable-experiment, or gradual-ramp-down
error_codes.UEV008: Experiment variant contract violation — version, unique variant ids, experiment_id, hypothesis, or control count invalid
